style.styleTitle: Lumineo Pre Lit 5ft Outdoor LED Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Make your outdoor space magical with the Lumineo LED Tree in White, standing at 5ft tall. This beautiful tree is crafted from iron and decorated with 1350 micro-sized bulbs, casting a warm, classic glow through its steady lighting function. The elegant white colour and gold colour cable add a touch of class to any setting, making it a perfect addition for festive occasions.</p><p>Whether you're lining your pathway or placing it as a centrepiece, this decorative tree brings life and warmth to your Christmas decorations. Transform your home’s exterior into a twinkling wonderland and revel in the joyful spirit that the Lumineo LED Tree White 5ft provides!</p>
